title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 92
description: Ten questions on Psalms 92: it is good to give thanks to Yahweh, and the righteous flourish like the palm tree.

questions.text: What does verse 1 call a good thing?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh."

answers.text: To give gifts to the poor

questions.text: When is God's faithfulness to be proclaimed, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night.

questions.text: How many strings does the lute in verse 3 have?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 mentions the ten-stringed lute, the harp and the lyre.

questions.text: Verse 5 says God's thoughts are very what?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep."

questions.text: Who does not know or understand, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "A senseless man doesn't know, neither does a fool understand this."

answers.text: A young child and a servant
A foreign king and his army
A senseless man and a fool

questions.text: Like what do the wicked spring up in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says the wicked spring up as the grass, but they will be destroyed forever.

questions.text: Like whose horn has God exalted the psalmist's horn?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says: "But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox."

questions.text: With what is the psalmist anointed in verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says: "I am anointed with fresh oil."

questions.text: Like which tree will the righteous flourish, according to verse 12?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: "The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree."

questions.text: When will they still produce fruit, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says: "They will still produce fruit in old age."
